# Core Rule 2 - No Exploiting or Cheating
- Under no circumstances are third party tools or outside information your character wouldn’t realistically know allowed to be used. This includes any method to communicate with others outside the SS14 client to gain information.
- Do not share current round information outside of the game until it is approved by administration or 30 minutes have passed.
- No exploiting bugs or game mechanics for any tangible benefit to yourself, exploiting AI behaviours or structures is strictly prohibited
- Sharing how to use bugs to others is prohibited and will be treated as exploiting.You can only share bugs or issues to administration via ahelp or discord in appropriate channels.
